meta.homeTitle: OK Lab Flensburg · Building open geodata together
meta.homeDescription: Help us build open GIS applications, PostGIS databases and open interfaces for Flensburg and Schleswig-Holstein.
meta.contributorsDescription: Meet the people behind OK Lab Flensburg’s open civic-tech projects.

hero.eyebrow: Open GIS · Open Data · Open Source
hero.title: Help us build the region’s open geodata infrastructure.
hero.intro: We develop open GIS applications, spatial databases and open interfaces for Flensburg and Schleswig-Holstein—voluntarily, collaboratively and in public on GitHub.

paths.title: Where would you like to start?
paths.intro: Bring your experience or learn with us. We tailor your first contribution to your current level.

webgis.text: Interactive maps, MapLibre, vector tiles and spatial tools.

geodata.text: PostgreSQL, PostGIS, spatial queries, indexes and migrations.

pipelines.title: Open up data
pipelines.text: Import pipelines, data quality, FastAPI and open interfaces.

featured.label: Flagship project
featured.text: A modular open-source WebGIS for exploring, drawing and analysing urban areas. Help us turn it into a reusable platform for cities and regions.

projectsSection.title: Open projects with real impact
projectsSection.intro: Our applications grow from concrete regional questions. Source code, data flows and project status are transparent.

description.openCityPlanner: Explore urban spaces, draw areas and run spatial analyses.
description.kulturbytes: Discover Flensburg Culture Night venues on an open map.
description.living: Compare German regions using open data and find a place that suits you.
description.bath: Discover bathing spots and waterside places across Schleswig-Holstein.
description.emergency: Quickly find nearby police stations in Schleswig-Holstein.
description.parcel: Interactive, unofficial parcel information without ownership data.
description.biotope: Explore protected and other biotopes across Schleswig-Holstein.
description.monuments: Discover Schleswig-Holstein’s cultural monuments on an open map.
description.school: Make schools and educational opportunities accessible through open data.
description.kita: Find childcare centres in Flensburg using open location and contact data.
description.api: Provide public datasets through an open, machine-readable interface.
description.transport: Show Flensburg public transport on a clear city map.
description.recycling: Map public glass and textile recycling containers transparently.
description.social: Visualise social data for planning and civil society.
description.surface: Compare land-use types across Schleswig-Holstein municipalities.
description.trees: Present Flensburg’s open street-tree data on an accessible map.
description.playgrounds: Make playgrounds and their facilities easier to find with open data.
description.accidents: Explore injury accidents spatially and across multiple years.
description.odd: Workshops, talks and exchange around open data in Flensburg.

contributors.title: Open software is teamwork.
contributors.intro: OK Lab Flensburg is powered by people who share knowledge, time and ideas. Our applications are built collaboratively—in Flensburg and through digital contributions on GitHub.
contributors.pageIntro: Whether it is a small data check, documentation or a new PostGIS feature, every contribution helps. You do not need to join regularly, and reviews are there to support you.
contributors.howText: Choose a public repository or open task, talk to us at a meetup, or get in touch. Learners are expressly welcome.
contributors.listedText: The list is based on public GitHub contributions to relevant repositories within the last 24 months. Only public profile data is shown, and bots are excluded.
contributors.optOutText: Would you like us to correct your details or remove your profile? Email us or open an issue in the website repository. We will update the local dataset.

volunteer.title: Your code can make a local difference.
volunteer.intro: Digital contributions make regional data findable, verifiable and reusable. Work in person or remotely, regularly or on a single issue.

points.small: Small pull requests, tests and data research are welcome.
points.support: We help you get started and provide constructive reviews.
points.learn: Learners can gain practical experience with manageable tasks.
points.impact: Open-source software and open data remain available to everyone.

tasks.title: Current ways to get started
tasks.intro: Real topic areas instead of invented tickets: check the GitHub repositories for current work and coordinate a suitable issue.
